a.name: Print board
a.description: Four tilted prints of the litter, four coats, captioned by hand in two offset columns right of the copy on the bone page.
a.differs_from: The photos are a pinned grid of tilted prints, a media position (grid) no built hero and no London pick uses; London's pick is a filmstrip along the foot of an inset panel.

b.name: Coat pair
b.description: Two girls of one litter, blue and blue and white, at staggered heights with an 'or' badge; one line says both are £1,700.
b.differs_from: Framed by hairline rules alone, not a band, card or inset panel, and the photos are a two-up comparison right of the copy; London's pick runs six photos along the foot.

c.name: Feature and three
c.description: One puppy large, bled to the screen's left edge with a caption pill, three more stacked beside it; copy right with a tick row.
c.differs_from: The photo column bleeds off the page edge with no card or band round it, a framing no built hero uses; London's pick keeps its photos inside an inset panel below the copy.
